content.text:
If you mean **Orca by Stably** (the AI coding workspace), its embedded browser works like this:

1. Open or create a worktree in Orca.
2. Open the **Browser** panel.
3. Enter a URL, or launch a local app preview.
4. Use persistent tabs to browse and sign in.
5. Click **Design Mode** to select webpage elements and send them to your coding agent for edits.
6. You can import cookies from Chrome or Edge with one click; Google logins must be performed directly in Orca. ([Orca browser overview](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/browser/overview), [Design Mode](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/browser/design-mode))
